'''Firewood shed I''' is a blueprint used to store and generate {{Item|Fuel}}, which is required by certain workstations to craft items.

All workstations of the same type within the same location share the same amount of Fuel. Each shed can store up to {{Item|Fuel|100}}.

== Obtaining ==

* Can be build in:
** {{Blueprint|Yard|text=no}} [[Yard]]
** {{Blueprint|Home|text=no}} [[Home]]
** {{Blueprint|Alchemy Lab|text=no}} [[Alchemy Lab]]
